blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution.
The Supreme Court acts as the Guardian of the Constitution.
India has the longest written constitution, featuring single citizenship and a federal system with a unitary tilt.
Article 368 governs the power and procedure to amend the Constitution.
Fundamental Rights are enforceable in court, while the Preamble serves as an interpretive guide.
TRAP: The Preamble is NOT enforceable in court, unlike Fundamental Rights which are legally enforceable.
Do not confuse adoption date (26 November 1949) with enforcement date (26 January 1950).
Article 368 is frequently tested as the specific article for Constitutional Amendments.

blocks.content:
• Adopted on: 26 November 1949

• Parliamentary system
